name: Pulses
scientific_name: Cajanus cajan / Vigna mungo (Red gram / Black gram)
description: Indispensable protein reservoir for Indian dietary security (Tur/Arhar, Urad, Moong, Chana). Natural soil restorers through atmospheric nitrogen fixation. Vulnerable to pod borer complex (Helicoverpa), sterility mosaic virus, and Fusarium wilt.
climate: Warm tropical to subtropical climate; drought hardy with deep taproot system.

soil.drainage_requirement: Very sensitive to waterlogging (causes collar rot and Phytophthora blight within 24 hours of standing water).
soil.organic_matter_requirement: Medium (>0.5% OC); benefits from Rhizobium and Phosphobacteria biofertilizers.

planting_seasons: Summer (February - March sowing for green gram/black gram)
seed_rate_per_ha: 12-15 kg/ha for Red gram; 20-25 kg/ha for Black gram.

growth_stages.description: Emergence, unifoliate to trifoliate transition, taproot elongation.
Intense branching, active nodulation fixing nitrogen.
critical_activities: Terminal nipping at 45-50 DAS to induce profuse lateral branches
vulnerabilities: Sterility Mosaic Disease (SMD transmitted by eriophyid mites)

growth_stages.description: Profuse yellow/red veined blooms followed by pod elongation.
critical_activities: Foliar spray of 2% DAP or Pulse Wonder at peak flowering

growth_stages.description: Pods turn brown to black, seeds rattle inside dry pods.
critical_activities: Protect against bruchid pulse beetle during drying

irrigation.frequency_days: 1 or 2 protective irrigations at critical stages in rainfed conditions

nutrients.basal_application: Full NPK at sowing (seeds inoculated with Rhizobium leguminosarum).
top_dressing_schedule: Foliar spray of 2% DAP or TNAU Pulse Wonder @ 5 kg/ha at flower initiation and 15 days later
micronutrient_requirements: Zinc sulphate @ 15 kg/ha basal or foliar 0.5% ZnSO4 spray

harvesting.duration_days: 130-160 days for medium duration red gram; 65-75 days for black gram
maturity_indices: 80-85% pods turn brownish black and dry
Seeds rattle inside pods when shaken
harvesting.harvesting_method: Cut plants with sickle close to ground, tie in bundles, sun-dry and thresh.
harvesting.average_yield_per_ha: 1.5 - 2.2 tonnes/ha grain yield under good management
harvesting.post_harvest_care: Sun dry grains to 9% moisture; treat with 1% edible vegetable oil (e.g. neem or mustard oil) to prevent pulse beetle attack.
